product.olivetti-m30002f.summary: Professional M300 with BA013/25, a 25 MHz 386SX, TOPCAT and integrated WD90C11.
product.olivetti-m30002f.history: The M300-02F is the professional model with the BA013/25 board, running at 25 MHz. The PCS 33 of late 1992 uses the same technical base, but the M300-02F has its own BIOS (5.01).
product.olivetti-m30002f.technical.verif: Cold POST, firmware memory paths, EMS programming and boot have been observed with the recovered model.
product.olivetti-m30002f.technical.limit: Bootable partial emulation. Warm Ctrl+Alt+Del and an independent DOS EMM driver remain pending. TOPCAT is an initial register model; PC87310 and common IDE provisionally aggregate the real 87C310, Acer FDC and MSI logic.
product.olivetti-m30002f.creation.storag: No hard disk: one 1.44 MB floppy drive
product.olivetti-m30002f.creation.model: M300-02F with a 25 MHz 386SX, 2 MB, integrated WD90C11 and one 1.44 MB 3.5-inch floppy drive
product.olivetti-m30002f.creation.note: This board’s BIOS supports only four drive types. If you add the disk, choose the type shown in the option in Setup. The disk connects to the board’s IDE interface.
product.olivetti-m30002f.technical.cpu: 25 MHz Intel 386SX on the BA013/25 board, with an i387SX socket. VLSI TOPCAT chipset: VL82C320 system controller and VL82C331 bus controller. Two 16-bit ISA slots on the bus expansion board.
product.olivetti-m30002f.technical.memor: Bank 0 with 2 MB soldered and bank 1 with two sockets for 1 M × 9 SIMMs (2 MB in total) or 4 M × 9 SIMMs (8 MB in total): 2, 4 or 10 MB. 80 ns access.
product.olivetti-m30002f.technical.video: Integrated VGA: Western Digital WD90C11A, WD90C64 clock generator and Brooktree BT476 DAC. BluMach uses its WD90C11 model with 512 KB.
product.olivetti-m30002f.technical.stora: 3.5-inch 1.44 MB or 5.25-inch 1.2 MB floppy drive, with an Acer controller and serial and parallel ports in the 87C310. The IDE disk uses a buffered interface on the board. The BIOS table has only four types; the first three are 980/5/17 (40 MB), 903/4/46 (85 MB) and 762/8/39 (120 MB).
product.olivetti-m30002f.technical.firmw: The preserved BIOS is 5.01 (08/24/92), 128 KB. The service guide mentions a later 5.03 that adds Quantum ELS and Conner CP30124 drives; it has not been found. It includes Resident Diagnostics and a Setup in ROM with six languages.
product.olivetti-m30002f.technical.comme: 25 MHz model with the BA013/25 board and 2 MB. The service guide presents it as the successor of the 16 MHz M300-02, with the same case and the same two-slot expansion board.
product.olivetti-m30002f.technical.servi: Olivetti Personal Computer - Pocket Service Guide, chapter 40: M300-02 / M300-02F.
